design.label: Design
design.hint: Figma: analysis, design system, components, generation, SEO

slicing.label: Slicing
slicing.hint: Figma → HTML + SCSS + Tailwind + JS, no CMS

wordpress.label: WordPress
wordpress.hint: ACF blocks, Twig, PHP, boilerplate rules

analyze-figma.description: Audit a Figma frame for block implementation readiness
analyze-figma.constraint: read-only, do not modify Figma files.

figma-design-system.description: Extract tokens from frames → create Design System page + Variables + Text Styles + `_patterns` cache
figma-design-system.constraint: may create a new page, Variables, and Text Styles; never modify existing design frames.

figma-components.description: Create Figma Components with variants from `_patterns` in `.wpaikit/design-system.json`

prep-figma.description: Prepare a page frame for code generation — tokens, Auto Layout, naming, components
prep-figma.constraint: works on a copy in "Dev Ready" page; never modifies original frames.

figma-sync-tokens.description: Sync `design-system.json` after designer manually edited Variables or Styles in Figma
figma-sync-tokens.constraint: read-only from Figma; updates only token sections of `design-system.json`; never deletes tokens (uses `deprecated: true`).

figma-update-design-system.description: Add new Figma frames to existing design system — merge tokens and update Figma page
figma-update-design-system.constraint: never deletes or modifies existing tokens; skips frames already in `sourceFrames`; never runs code generation automatically.

generate-design.description: Interactively collect design materials and generate a UI design directly in Figma
generate-design.constraint: writes only to the designer-specified target Figma file; never modifies the DS file; never generates Mobile without explicit request; always runs quality check before generating.

design-quality-check.description: Audit a design brief (no URL) or existing Figma design (with URL) for AI slop patterns and quality issues
design-quality-check.constraint: brief mode: read-only on text input; design mode: read-only on Figma unless designer confirms fixes; never blocks generation over a designer override.

figma-seo-structure.description: Audit a Figma page for structural SEO → build missing blocks in Figma + SEO annotations
figma-seo-structure.constraint: audit is read-only; builds only after the user approves the plan; never edits original frames unless the user explicitly says to edit in place; all invented data is flagged as placeholder.

figma-seo-texts.description: Generate multilingual SEO texts from a Figma page — skips dynamic blocks, localizes per language
figma-seo-texts.constraint: read-only from Figma; never modifies Figma layers; never skips confirmation of block list or keywords; only writes the output `.md` file.

figma-to-block-html.description: Slice a Figma block frame into HTML + SCSS (Tailwind `@apply`) + JS for interactive blocks
figma-to-block-html.constraint: static front-end only; never overwrites files without confirmation.

figma-to-block.description: Generate PHP + Twig + SCSS + ACF JSON for a WordPress block from a Figma frame
figma-to-block.constraint: run from the active theme root containing `blocks/`, `views/` and `acf-json/`; never overwrite files without confirmation.

design-system-to-code.description: Generate Twig components + SCSS partials + update tailwind.config.js from design-system.json
design-system-to-code.constraint: reads `.wpaikit/design-system.json`; never overwrites files without confirmation.

scan-components.description: Scan SCSS and Twig files, build `.wpaikit/components-registry.md` for reuse in generation commands
scan-components.constraint: read-only scan; only writes `.wpaikit/components-registry.md`; never modifies SCSS or Twig files.

validate-code.description: Validate SCSS, Twig, PHP against coding rules — report violations and fix them
validate-code.constraint: fixes only after reporting the violations.

get-comment-for-frontend.description: Generate a `.md` developer reference listing all ACF blocks on a page with Twig, SCSS, and JS paths
get-comment-for-frontend.constraint: read-only DB query (SELECT only); never prints DB credentials; writes only the output `.md` file.

scan-project.description: Scan any project and write the `.wpaikit/project.md` knowledge base
scan-project.constraint: read-only scan; only writes `.wpaikit/project.md`; never prints secrets or credentials.

setup-fonts.description: Audit fonts vs design-system.json, remove unused, convert to woff/woff2, generate @font-face SCSS
setup-fonts.constraint: never deletes font files without user confirmation; never references ttf/otf in generated CSS.
